anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: Quoted: our Passover has been sacrificed, Christ.

pass_a_gloss: let us search of the true sheep, the apostle confessing the sheep of our pascha to be Christ, saying: For also our pascha was sacrificed, Christ, whose fleshes and bones and blood, as was shown before, are the divine writings, which if we eat, we have Christ,
pass_b_english: let us search the true sheep. The apostle confesses that the sheep of our Passover is Christ, saying: "For our Passover also has been sacrificed, Christ," (1 Corinthians 5:7) whose flesh and bones and blood, as was shown before, are the divine scriptures, which if we eat, we have Christ,
